title: Über die Riemannsche Funktionalgleichung der ζ-Funktion (Erste Mitteilung)
version: Original1921 journal scan; fifteen-page paper extracted from GDZ volume10.
read_scope: Original scanned pp240–242 only, including Satz1 and the two-series extension. Full paper accessed but not read.
technical_review: Exact hypotheses visually checked against the original German scan. Later Burnol theorem supplies the weaker-growth converse used in the model bridge.
main_result_inspected: Finite poles, global finite growth, an ordinary DS absolutely convergent for Re(s)>1, and exact conductor-one zeta FE imply cζ.

title: Deux extensions de Théorèmes de Hamburger (portant sur l’équation fonctionnelle de la fonction zêta)
version: arXiv v2, 7 January2012, fourteen-page preprint; published identity Crossref-verified; journal text not compared.
read_scope: Complete fourteen-page primary preprint read. Theorem1 and Corollaries1–2 proof pp7–10 reconstructed with an explicit external Mellin/distribution dictionary dependency; not a fully independent audit of that dictionary or Theorems2–3.
technical_review: Scoped technical reconstruction: Phragmén–Lindelöf step, integer-support/Fourier periodicity, Bernoulli removals, and shift asymptotics. Burnol2007 Theorem4.54/Remark4.29 not audited here.
main_result_inspected: Ordinary DS convergence somewhere, finite poles, weak strip growth and dual right-half-plane control force a finite sum of even zeta shifts. Corollary2 forces cζ under a superpolynomially fast real dual limit.

title: Hamburger’s Theorem on ζ(s) and the Abundance Principle for Dirichlet Series with Functional Equations
version: Original2000 chapter identity; accessible scanned reprint bears2020 distribution watermark. Exact edition comparison not performed.
read_scope: Selected pp201–205 and211–216 read; pp201,211–212 key formulas visually checked. Modular-integral construction pp206–210 not fully read. Author restates Knopp1994 Theorem1 on p212;1994 publisher text inaccessible.
technical_review: Independent normalization check: R(z)=π^(−z)Γ(z)φ(z), symmetry z→1/2−z, ordinary φ(z) DS becomes sqrt(integer) frequencies in conventional zeta variable s=2z.
main_result_inspected: Abundance for a larger Dirichlet-frequency class, with arbitrary rational polar data subject to finite-codimension conditions; not an exception to the ordinary integer-frequency zeta converse.

title: Dirichlet Series with Periodic Coefficients, Riemann’s Functional Equation, and Real Zeros of Dirichlet L-Functions
version: arXiv v4,10 September2021 inspected; published2023 identity Crossref-verified; journal text not accessed/compared.
read_scope: Complete seven-page preprint read, with p4 visually checked. Direct FE proof Theorem2.1(i) and ordinary-series Corollary2.2 checked. Cited zero-distribution results not independently audited.
technical_review: Main examples avoid the exact Hamburger hypotheses via generalized frequencies or Dirichlet-polynomial pole clearing. Background p4 Knopp(H2,H3,K) attribution has unresolved variable-normalization concern; no main theorem failure established and no journal comparison claimed.
main_result_inspected: Explicit q^sL(s,χ)+G(χ)L(s,barχ) has the exact even zeta FE; multiplying by symmetric inverse q^s+q^(1−s) yields an ordinary-series example with a different pole-clearing hypothesis.

title: Entrelacement de co-Poisson
version: Publisher2007 PDF from Numdam; source-version history not audited.
read_scope: Selected p577,pp580–585,590–593: Definitions4.11,4.27,4.45,4.53; Remark4.29; Theorems4.26,4.31,4.54; Lemma4.50 and Proposition4.51. Whole78-page paper not read.
technical_review: Scoped reconstruction of moderate Mellin/Fourier dictionary, especially Theorem4.31 converse and4.54 meromorphic reduction. Standard Hardy Paley–Wiener/Nevanlinna/Fourier–Mellin results accepted; earlier distribution-smoothing lemmas not fully audited.
main_result_inspected: Even extended-S tempered distributions correspond to moderate meromorphic F with moderate χ(s)F(1−s); uniqueness modulo quasi-homogeneous distributions, or exact uniqueness when normalized to vanish near0.

title: On Dirichlet series satisfying Riemann’s functional equation
version: Original1994 journal scan, printedpp361–363 accessed via GDZ IIIF; only three-page excerpt downloaded.
read_scope: Original printedpp361–363 visually read, including exact R normalization, conditions1–3, Theorem1, and beginning of Riemann–Hecke–Bochner correspondence. Full twelve-page work not accessed/read.
technical_review: Original p361 has R(s)=π^(−s)Γ(s)φ(s), reflection1/2−s. Original p362 abundance Theorem1 retains this normalization and ordinary φ(s); restrictive3(a) additionally requires ordinary φ(s/2). This confirms the normalization in the2000 author restatement. Construction/proof not audited.
main_result_inspected: Abundance under ordinary φ(s), finite genus after polynomial pole clearing, gamma Γ(s), reflection1/2−s, with finite-codimension rational polar-data statement.
